items.title: 5 Best Stocks to Buy After Democrats’ Election Sweep, According to CIBC
items.summary: CIBC Capital Markets recommended a list of top stock picks after the Democratic sweep of Congress, according to CNBC, citing a potentially tougher regulatory environment for corporate America.
